title.en: Send ERC-20 tokens from the Safe
title.zh-TW: 從 Safe 轉出 ERC-20 代幣

summary.en: The Safe calls `transfer` directly on the token contract you pick, sending the amount you type to the recipient you pick. There is only one call. It goes through no router or other contract, and leaves no allowance.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 直接呼叫你選的代幣合約的 `transfer`，把你填的金額轉給你選的收款人。只有一個呼叫，不經過任何路由或其他合約，也不留下授權。

text.en: A plain token transfer: the Safe calls transfer on the token contract directly and leaves no allowance.
text.zh-TW: 單純的代幣轉帳：Safe 直接呼叫代幣合約的 transfer，不留下授權。

pastTxsConclusion.en: Only USP's search covers a year; USDC and USDT cover about an hour, the others 3 to 46 days, and older blocks were not searched. For each token the card can name, the fitting transfers measured moved exactly the stated amount. The largest misfit group, 113 Safe transactions, delegatecalls contracts listed in DeFi Saver's GitHub address file; what each did was not read. The rest are batches, or EOA calls to unverified contracts or with nonstandard data. verify refuses them all.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 只有 USP 搜滿一年；USDC、USDT 約一小時，其他 3 到 46 天，更早的沒搜。卡片能選的每個代幣，量過的轉帳都剛好轉出所寫的數量。最多的不符合是 113 筆 Safe delegatecall 到 DeFi Saver GitHub 地址檔列出的合約，每筆做什麼沒讀。其餘是批次，或 EOA 呼叫未驗證的合約、資料不標準。verify 全部拒絕。
